card.statement:
For any $\mu,\nu\in\mathbf{Y}_{\succeq 0}$ such that $\nu\preceq\mu$ and $\Gamma\in\mathfrak{P}(\nu)$ , the condition $(\star)^{\mu}_{\Gamma}$ is equivalent to the condition that for any $n\in\mathbb{Z}$ , the sheaf $\mathcal{H}^{n}((\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}})_{|{}_{\Gamma}\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}})$ is locally constant. Moreover, if these conditions are satisfied we have

$P^{C,\mu}_{\Gamma}(q)=\sum_{n\geq 0}\rank\bigl(\mathcal{H}^{-|\Gamma|+\langle\nu-\mu,2\rho\rangle-n}((\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}})_{|{}_{\Gamma}\overline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}})\bigr)\cdot q^{n}.$

When $C$ is projective of genus $g$ , we will consider in parallel the following condition, for any $\lambda\in\mathbf{Y}$ , $\nu\in\mathbf{Y}_{\succeq 0}$ and $\Gamma\in\mathfrak{P}(\nu)$ :

$(\star\star)^{\lambda}_{\Gamma}\quad\text{for any $n\in\mathbb{Z}$, the sheaf $\mathcal{H}^{n}((\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{B}^{\lambda}})_{|{}_{\Gamma}\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}^{\lambda}_{B}})$ is locally constant.}$

When this condition is satisfied it makes sense to consider the polynomial

$Q^{C,\lambda}_{\Gamma}(q):=\sum_{n\geq 0}\rank\bigl(\mathcal{H}^{-|\Gamma|+\langle\nu-\lambda,2\rho\rangle-(g-1)\dim(B)-n}((\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}^{\lambda}_{B}})_{|{}_{\Gamma}\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}^{\lambda}_{B}})\bigr)\cdot q^{n}.$

Here again the curve $C$ will be omitted from notation when it is clear from the context. As above we have $Q^{C,\lambda}_{\Gamma}\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}[q]$ , and this polynomial has constant term $0$ unless $\nu=0$ (hence $\Gamma=\varnothing$ ), in which case we have $Q^{C,\lambda}_{\varnothing}=1$ . (Eventually we will see that $(\star\star)^{\lambda}_{\Gamma}$ is always satisfied, and that the polynomials $Q^{C,\lambda}_{\Gamma}(q)$ depend neither on $C$ , nor on $\lambda$ .)

We start with an easy case.
card.label: Lemma 5.1

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
